notes.title: Korean language version now available
notes.notes:
We are very pleased to tell you that The Dark Eye: Book of Heroes is now available in a Korean language version on Steam.

We encourage you to invite your Korean speaking friends on great new adventures in Aventuria.
To seek out treasures and loot, battle monsters and creatures and complete quests and puzzles in the multiplayer co-op experience that The Dark Eye: Book of Heroes offers.

The Korean language version comes complete with the content of previously released patches. 
If you are looking for a guide to get started, have a look at the  ‘Compendium of Heroes’  that community member Mintar put together – please note that the guide is only in English though.

And if you wonder how adventuring in Aventuria looks like in Korean, have a peek at this bunch of new screenshots we just had made.

notes.title: Version 1.0.6 patch notes
notes.notes:
Version 1.0.6 of Book of Heroes is live. The main focus this time was on adding Russian as a language option and fixing issues with the existing languages.

Added

   Support for Russian language


Localization fixes

   Dice rolls in tooltips etc. are now localized
   Suggested character names are now localized
   Henchman names are now localized
   Inrah Shrine hint is now properly localized
   The Long Action Bar now uses localized spell and interaction names
   Fixed unlocalized "Opportunity Attack" messages in Combat Log
   Fixed some spells displaying two log messages, with one incorrectly localized
   Fixed various texts not updating when the game language was changed
   Fixed various other untranslated texts ("Ancient Blessing", "Paused" etc.)


Other fixes

   Journal now scrolls instead of shrinking the text to unreadable sizes with long storyline texts
   Fixed characters getting stuck when interrupting a long action with another long action
   Fixed Klarum Purum triggering on failed check
   Fixed Catch Blade 
   Fixed Card Details tooltips triggering even when the details were hidden

notes.title: Russian language version out now

notes.title: Version 1.0.5 is out
notes.notes:
Book of Heroes version 1.0.5 is live with another batch of fixes and improvements. Thanks to everyone for the reports, suggestions and other feedback!

Added

  Damage bonuses for melee weapons based on the weapon’s Primary Attribute and Damage Threshold, as per DSA 5e rules (+1 DP per Attribute Point above the Damage Threshold)


Fixed

  Fixed a broken storyline stage causing characters to fail to load
  Fixed Armillary adventure exit door not always opening when it should
  Shrine puzzles will no longer prevent completing the adventure
  Fixed Encumbrance getting removed when a character is knocked down
  Fixed Liturgical Shield giving protection on failed spell check
  Fixed statues of Phex not doing what they were supposed to
  Cave spiders are no longer Sentient (will not answer to provoke)
  Fixed inaccessible containers in some places
  Fixed crafting recipe for Gas Trap
  Fixed progression card AP costs sometimes being higher than they were meant to
  Fixed “regained X KP” (instead of AE) messages for mages when resting
  Fixed item names overflowing in tavern UI
  Fixed Raven’s Beak damage bonus vs. undead
  Fixed Adersin Sword damage value
  Fixed Pastilles Against Pain duration


Improved

  Revamped progression cards relating to gaining new Spells
  Correct rounding when calculating Derived Characteristics (round up when fractional part is 0.5 or higher)
  Balanced ingredient prices
  Improved henchman behaviour after “Follow Me” toggle
  Improved indicators for friendly creatures (e.g. Treants and Tree Dragons) to more clearly differentiate them from enemies
  Improved usability of Lost City cogs puzzle
  Improved Master Chest encounter to make it more clear how it works
  Improved usability of Forest pressure plate puzzle
  Loot dropped by enemies is now highlighted to make it less easy to miss
  Limited Stupor from Old Soldier encounter to 1 level
  Increased Quicksilver duration

notes.title: Version 1.0.4 is out (Character loading hotfix)
notes.notes:
Hello all!

Version 1.0.4 is now out on Steam. The changelog this time is notably short:

   Fixed characters failing to load if they had spells at spell rating 26 or higher.


Rest assured, this is not everything we've been working on since 1.0.3, but due to the severity of the issue we wanted to get a fix out as soon as possible. More fixes and improvements are in various stages of the implementation and QA process for version 1.0.5.

notes.title: Version 1.0.3 is out
notes.notes:
Hello!

Book of Heroes version 1.0.3 is now live with another batch of fixes and improvements. More are in the pipeline. Big thanks again to everyone for the bug reports and other feedback!

Fixes

	Fixed all characters loading without hair after double-tapping Esc to skip the intro.
	Fixed permanent hair loss if the hair fails to load for any reason in the future. Unfortunately, there's no way to automatically fix existing characters that were already saved with missing hair.
	Fixed “Find the bandit with the amulet” personal quest only working for the Host.
	Fixed Dialogue window getting stuck open between adventures.
	Fixed Rest window getting stuck open between adventures.
	Fixed Grey Mage henchman missing Spellcaster advantage.
	Fixed henchmen attacking tameable creatures.
	Fixed friendly creatures (such as Tree Dragons) preventing Rest.
	Fixed double log message from Balsam Salabundle, with one of the messages broken.
	Fixed roads abruptly ending at the Boronyard in Forest.
	Fixed henchmen getting stuck in the pit in the “bridge over pit” room in Forest.
	Fixed an unreachable “Loose Tile” in Dungeon maps.
	Fixed some typos and mistakes in texts.


Improvements

	You can now spend silver to redraw basic (non-upgraded) Progression Cards at the Fortune Teller in the Tavern. E.g. redrawing a “Squire” card will replace it with another “Squire” card.
	Henchmen now respond to “Help” and “Heal” requests from the Chat Wheel by attempting to stabilize or heal the player.
	Henchmen respond in chat to Chat Wheel and Map Pins that they understand.
	Tweaked henchman behaviour when reacting to Map Pins to make them more responsive.
	Improved “Forge of Agrimoth” end puzzle (more clear indication when it’s completed, some other tweaks).
	Reduced enemy Disengage frequency.
	Show log message when damage is blocked by Gardianum or Liturgical Shield.
	Removed “Luck” advantage from Gambler origin (no gameplay effect).

notes.title: Version 1.0.2 is out
notes.notes:
For the past few days, we at Random Potion have been assessing, reproducing and fixing the most acute issues discovered since launch, and are now ready to launch version 1.0.2. 

Our priority right now is in fixing bugs, and that work is still ongoing. We do also follow the discussions and reviews here on Steam, and are in active talks with the publisher to determine the best steps forward.

Thanks to everyone for the bug reports, constructive criticism and other feedback!


Changelog:

 Fixed players with certain system locales (at least Norwegian Bokmål) being unable to progress beyond the main menu.
 Fixed "Steam Default" language option not working. The game would always start in english, unless the "Deutsch" option was selected in the in-game options, instead of "Steam Default (Deutsch)".
 Downtuned "Sleepwalker" disadvantage and reduced its proc chance. It will no longer teleport you miles away from the party, behind locked doors or, in one case of a misplaced spawn point, inside walls.
 Show "Sleepwalker" floater on the affected character after resting finishes, to reduce confusion over the character having moved on his/her own.
 Fixed the game being un-quittable when the player has no characters.
 Reduced memory overhead from having multiple characters in your account. More work needs to be done on memory usage, but character count should no longer affect it as much.
 Enemy loot (such as the dungeon exit key) is now spawned at the feet of the downed enemy. This should prevent it from ending up behind locked doors or at the bottom of a lake.
 Regeneration is now shown in the Log while resting.
 Elves can now acquire spells via character progression
 Lower difficulty for the early adventures
 Cultists are not as spell happy anymore
 Enemies leave less traps
 Removed Luck advantage from new characters (it has no function in game)
 Henchmen finish combat before stabilising
 Henchmen now react to 'Trap' map marker
 Adventure Results screen layout fixed
 Fixed personal quest triggering multiple times
 Added tooltips to progression cards
 Fixed movement speed from Axxeleratus never ending
 Fixed “Fire And Brimstone” spell particles never ending
 Fixed several ESC and System Menu bugs

notes.title: Release date and pricing announced
notes.notes:
Sharpen your swords, shine your armor, load your pack with dungeon rations, and get ready for adventure!

We are very happy to announce a June 9, 2020 release date for our PC action-RPG The Dark Eye: Book of Heroes.

The game will be available on Steam for 29.99 EUR.

Book of Heroes is based on the massively popular tabletop RPG The Dark Eye, which is one of the most beloved pen-and-paper RPGs in Germany – right up there with Dungeons and Dragons!
 
The game has you rolling up a character, creating their backstory, and heading off in search of action and
adventure in the mystical lands of Aventuria. Will you find fame and fortune, or foolhardy folly?
The choice is yours!
